newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct-Dec output seen up 2.6 pct -- MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct-Dec output seen up 2.6 pct -- MITI.

text.p: Japan's industrial production in the October-December period is expected to rise 2.6 percent from the previous quarter, a senior official at the Ministry of International Trade and Industry told reporters on Tuesday.
Production in the October-December quarter is likely show a year-on-year rise of 4.2 percent, the official said.
The ministry announced industrial output rose a preliminary 1.0 percent in September from the previous month.
The ministry official said Japan's overall inventory situation is improving.
The Trade Ministry has been saying that inventory adjustment had not been progressing smoothly.
"We dropped that phrase for the first time since February and the overall inventory situation is now improving," she said.
Increased production of cars, tankers, and general machinery have all contributed to the month-on-month rise in September output.
